sys_script.message:
if (current.fund_case) {
        //check if task is having case or not
        var caseSysId = current.fund_case;
        var taskGR = new GlideRecord('x_hsb11_mss_fund_0_funds_task');
        taskGR.addQuery('fund_case', caseSysId);
        taskGR.query();
        var totalTasks = 0,
            closeTasks = 0,
            openTasks = 0;
        while (taskGR.next()) {
            totalTasks++;
            if (taskGR.state == 203 || taskGR.state == 201)
                closeTasks++;
            else
                openTasks++;
        }
        var caseGR = new GlideRecord('x_hsb11_mss_fund_0_funds_case');
        if (caseGR.get(caseSysId)) {
            if (totalTasks == 0)
                caseGR.funds_tasks_status = 'No Tasks';
            else if (openTasks > 0)
                caseGR.funds_tasks_status = 'Open Tasks';
            else if (closeTasks == totalTasks)
                caseGR.funds_tasks_status = 'All Closed';
            caseGR.update();
        }
    }
